subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Letter formation of 's' (finger paint, crayon, sand tray)

show.line: Let's write s. Curve this way, then curve back, like a snake. s, s, sun!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says s, as in sun.
This letter says s. Say the sound!
Trace s with your finger. Curve one way, then curve back.
Look carefully. Which one is s? It starts at the top and curves like a snake.

hints: Start at the top. Curve left, then curve right.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write s for sun.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One round curve. Look, I wrote s!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is c. s curves back the other way too.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Curve one way, then curve back. That is s!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter s, say its sound and trace it.
